competing_explanations.statement: The election-day European currency rally may have been a largely complete positioning adjustment rather than a continuing macro repricing.
Cheaper energy can strengthen US demand and maintain tight Fed policy as well as help Europe.
The supplied target markers, a cloned move and sample median, are not independent economic fair values; the thesis may be wrong despite attractive conditional payoff arithmetic.
Strong US employment/inflation or a wider credit/funding shock can renew USD demand even as rate yields fall; neither lower US rates nor weaker equities alone guarantees EUR gains.
